abi: r0 points to 14 words: source,destination,source width,height,destination width,height,source stride,destination stride,crop row,reserved,crop column,reserved,opacity,unsigned rotation degrees; returns r0 from cache write

seams.law: cache source extent before pixel accesses
cache destination extent after pixel accesses; propagate returned r0

laws: Pointers clear bit30 after source crop arithmetic; crop offset is (row*source_stride+column)*2 with wrapping u32 arithmetic.
Scale opacity zero skips coordinate tables and pixel writes. Both cache operations still execute.
Opacity is full u32, not truncated: values at least128 overwrite; lower values blend every byte with denominator128.

Scale maps store floor(wrapping_u32(index*source_dimension*1024)/destination_dimension) at95e1f8 and9621f8, then sample coordinates shift right10. Map loop bound is destination_dimension<<10 modulo2^32.
Scale and destination row strides floor to packed pairs. Rotation source row stride uses signed arithmetic shift right1.
Odd destination widths discard the last pixel. Chroma is the floor average of the two selected packed pairs, while luma selects by coordinate parity.
Overlap is forward row/pair traversal with immediate writes, not snapshot copying.
Rotation bounding box transforms source corners using wrapping signed products and arithmetic shift10. Destination dimensions do not clip it.

Rotation includes source coordinates equal to source width or height, not just strictly lower coordinates. Out-of-bounds samples fall back to the current destination pair, retaining coordinate parity. With valid y and invalid x it first reads the source pair at x clamped to0 or width; fp-108 is initialized at6e1858 before every nonempty row.
Sine/cosine accept unsigned degrees modulo360 and load signed fixed10 values from their original read-only tables.
No request-adjacent descriptor writes occur. Reserved words and request storage remain unchanged.
gaps: Scale dimensions whose left-shift10 is zero but dimension is nonzero consume stale lookup scratch; caller owns scratch validity and mapped extents. No validation or new failure status is invented.
Zero source dimensions can still read source coordinate0. Source and destination allocation bounds remain caller preconditions; rotation has no error return independent of cache completion.
